provenance_note: Mined from the MIT-licensed sage3648/mythicsim-forever-engine repository's own client-data extraction (data/spells.jsonl), which that project's NOTICE.md credits as derived from the WoW Forever beta client. Spot-checked against foreverdb.net (an independently-run WoW Forever client-data site, robots.txt-cleared for AI fetch) for shadow_bolt and immolate; both matched exactly. This pack shares no code or files with wowsimforever's own data-packs/ - it is an independent extraction for this separate project.
known_conflicts: The sibling wowsimforever project's docs/PLAN.md and data-packs/ (an unrelated, separate project in this same repo) recorded Shadow Bolt's max-rank average as 251 as of 2026-10-17/18, sourced from thewowdb.com at client build 1.60.1.70450. This pack's value (268, from build 1.60.1.70425, confirmed by two independent sources as of 2026-10-23) is HIGHER, not a rounding difference. Build 70450 postdates 70425, so this is most likely a genuine beta balance pass between those two builds, not a sourcing error on either side. Not resolved further since this pack does not depend on or reference that project's data.

shadow_bolt.source: sage3648/mythicsim-forever-engine (MIT license), data/spells.jsonl, client build 1.60.1.70425, spell id 25307. Cross-checked against foreverdb.net/spell/25307 on 2026-10-23: site shows "253 to 283 Shadow damage" (avg 268) and SPCoef 0.857 - exact match to mined base_points=268, sp_coefficient=0.857.

immolate.source: sage3648/mythicsim-forever-engine (MIT license), data/spells.jsonl, client build 1.60.1.70425, spell id 25309. Cross-checked against foreverdb.net/spell/25309 on 2026-10-23: site shows direct 158 Fire damage and "275 Fire damage over 15 sec" dot total, SPCoef 0.2 - exact match to mined direct base_points=158, periodic 55/tick x5 ticks=275, sp_coefficient=0.2.. Note: foreverdb.net labels this 'Rank 8' (its own rank count scheme for the 8 total Immolate ranks); this pack's ladder also has it as the 8th and final entry, so the numbering is consistent, not a conflict.
